en.name: VirtuBand: Music Studio
en.title: VirtuBand — Music Studio
en.subtitle: Play, record & compose
en.short_description: Play virtual instruments, record multi-track songs, and compose with AI help.
en.description:
VirtuBand is a music studio that fits in your pocket. Play virtual instruments with your fingers, layer them into multi-track recordings, and get an AI suggestion when you cannot find the next part.

—— Play ——

A library of virtual instruments — keys, strings, drums and more — each with its own playable interface rather than one generic keyboard. Open an instrument to see its detail view, tune it, and play.

—— Record ——

STUDIO
A multi-track workspace. Lay down a part, then another over it, and build a song a track at a time.

TRACKS AND RECORDINGS
Everything you record is saved to your library, where you can rename, replay, and organise it.

—— Compose ——

AI COMPOSE
Describe what you want, or hand it what you have, and get a suggested part back. Useful when a song stalls halfway.

JAM
A looser space for playing along and improvising without setting up a full project.

—— Built to get out of your way ——

• Dashboard showing your recent work
• Dark interface designed for playing in low light
• Sign-in is optional — tap "Continue as Guest" and every feature is available
• Works offline; nothing you record needs a network to save

—— Optional Premium ——

A Premium tier is available. The free app is fully usable without it.

en.promotional_text: Play a room full of virtual instruments, layer them into multi-track songs, and let the AI composer suggest a part when you are stuck. No gear required.
en.release_notes:
First release of VirtuBand.

• A library of virtual instruments, each with its own playable interface
• Multi-track Studio for layering a song a part at a time
• Recordings library with rename and replay
• AI Compose for a suggested part when a song stalls
• Jam mode for loose improvisation
• Works offline; sign-in is optional via "Continue as Guest"

Feedback is welcome at contact@safecodeg.com.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
VirtuBand is a music studio that fits in your pocket. Play virtual instruments with your fingers, layer them into multi-track recordings, and get an AI suggestion when you cannot find the next part.

Intended audience:
Play, record & compose

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google AdMob — advertising
- Apple In-App Purchase — paid features
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (locale 1, locale 10, locale 11, locale 12, locale 2, locale 3, locale 4, locale 5, locale 6, locale 7, locale 8, locale 9). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
